text: 深圳市房地产中介协会发布数据显示，上周深圳全市二手房录得1395套，环比上升9.4%，创近4周以来的新高，其中二手住宅录得1272套，环比上升7.8%，“金九”成色初显。此外，深圳贝壳研究院监测的数据显示，9月1日至13日贝壳深圳合作门店新房认购量较8月同期增长26%，二手房签约量较8月同期增长22%。
text_en: The Shenzhen Real Estate Intermediary Association released data showing that last week Shenzhen recorded 1,395 second-hand home transactions citywide, up 9.4% from the previous week and a new high in nearly four weeks, of which 1,272 were second-hand residential properties, up 7.8% from the previous week, showing an initial strong performance for the 'Golden September.' In addition, data monitored by Shenzhen Beike Research Institute showed that from September 1 to 13, new home subscriptions at Beike's partner stores in Shenzhen increased by 26% compared with the same period in August, and second-hand home contract signings increased by 22% compared with the same period in August.
